question: Should OpenClaw accept selectable quick/full pull request templates in `.github/PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE/` now, or keep the single fallback template?
rationale: The implementation is on the correct GitHub-supported surface, but the linked canonical issue is explicitly product-decision-gated and this changes contributor workflow expectations rather than fixing a broken code path.

options.title: Accept after current-head proof
options.body: Approve the quick/full template direction, ask for fresh current-head render proof, and land once the PR is up to date.

options.title: Keep one fallback template
options.body: Reject the workflow split and close this PR while leaving the current single fallback template as the supported contributor path.

options.title: Narrow before landing
options.body: Request a maintainer-authored or CONTRIBUTING-aligned revision before adding selectable template files.

recommendation.title: Accept after current-head proof
recommendation.body: Approve the quick/full template direction, ask for fresh current-head render proof, and land once the PR is up to date.

likelyOwner.reason: Prior commits show repeated ownership of PR-template wording and review-guidance structure, making this the best history-backed routing candidate for the workflow choice.
